senses.gloss: = h. צידה, outfit for travelling, provision; dying outfit, shroud; trnsf. good deeds.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 132:15">Targ. Ps. CXXXII, 15</cite>.—Pl. <he>זְוָודִין</he>, <he>זְוָ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 42:25">Targ. O. Gen. XLII, 25</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:16">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>זַוְודָּאַי קלילי</he> my provision (for the journey of death) is scanty.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28b:7">M. Kat. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>דשלימו זְוָודֵיה</he> whose outfit for death is completed, v. <cite ref="A02376"><he>אִסְטְלָא</he></cite>.—<he>זְוָודָתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 27b:14">Ib. 27ᵇ</cite> <he>צבית ז׳ לאידך</he> prepare the burial outfit for another son.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 17a:3">Ab. Zar. 17ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="G00131">preced.</cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 12a">Kidd. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ דאודדי</he> (Ar. ed. Koh. <he>זְוָודֵי</he>, pl.) a bundle of tow cotton (being of small value).
